selected_evidence.requirement: Run inventory-worker as dedicated unprivileged inventorysvc account
selected_evidence.summary: Service is active and enabled; its process runs as UID/GID 996 with zero effective capabilities and NoNewPrivileges enabled.

selected_evidence.requirement: Root-owned chroot with /var/lib/inventory as the only writable application directory
selected_evidence.summary: Chroot directories are root-owned except /var/lib/inventory. Namespace evidence shows / mounted read-only and only the state directory mounted read-write; unprivileged write checks confirm the policy.

selected_evidence.requirement: Healthy background worker and persistent application data
selected_evidence.summary: Heartbeat advanced before and after reboot, the service remained active, and the persistent start counter advanced from 1 to 2.

selected_evidence.requirement: Preserve installed operating-system release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: Pre-change, pre-reboot, and post-reboot evidence consistently reports RHEL 9.8 and kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8.x86_64.

Healthy baseline used boot ID 9feeb0bb-6fe6-40fb-9831-d869ed07631c; the native delayed reboot was acknowledged; node1 returned with boot ID 943f0636-a778-4da2-a31b-b70f7467f0b0; service, confinement, heartbeat, and persistent data then recovered.

set -eu
if ! getent passwd inventorysvc >/dev/null; then
  useradd --system --home-dir /nonexistent --shell /sbin/nologin --user-group inventorysvc
fi
CHROOT=/srv/inventory-worker/root
install -d -o root -g root -m 0755 /srv/inventory-worker "$CHROOT"
install -d -o root -g root -m 0755 "$CHROOT/bin" "$CHROOT/usr" "$CHROOT/usr/bin" "$CHROOT/usr/local" "$CHROOT/usr/local/bin" "$CHROOT/var" "$CHROOT/var/lib"

install -o root -g root -m 0755 /bin/bash "$CHROOT/bin/bash"
install -o root -g root -m 0755 /usr/bin/sleep "$CHROOT/usr/bin/sleep"
ln -s bash "$CHROOT/bin/sh"
for BIN in /bin/bash /usr/bin/sleep; do
  ldd "$BIN" | awk '$3 ~ /^\// {print $3} $1 ~ /^\// {print $1}'
done | sort -u | while IFS= read -r LIB; do
  install -d -o root -g root -m 0755 "$CHROOT$(dirname "$LIB")"

done

fi
chcon --reference=/bin/bash "$CHROOT/bin/bash"
chcon --reference=/usr/bin/sleep "$CHROOT/usr/bin/sleep"
getent passwd inventorysvc
find /srv/inventory-worker/root -maxdepth 4 -printf '%M %u:%g %p -> %l\n' | sort

commands.command:
set -eu
CHROOT=/srv/inventory-worker/root
cat > "$CHROOT/usr/local/bin/inventory-worker" <<'INVENTORY_WORKER'
#!/bin/bash
set -u
count=0
if [ -r /var/lib/inventory/starts ]; then
  IFS= read -r count < /var/lib/inventory/starts || count=0
fi
case "$count" in
  ''|*[!0-9]*) count=0 ;;
esac
count=$((count + 1))
printf '%s\n' "$count" > /var/lib/inventory/starts
trap 'exit 0' TERM INT
while :; do
  printf '%(%s)T\n' -1 > /var/lib/inventory/heartbeat
  /usr/bin/sleep 10
done
INVENTORY_WORKER
chown root:root "$CHROOT/usr/local/bin/inventory-worker"
chmod 0755 "$CHROOT/usr/local/bin/inventory-worker"
chcon --reference=/bin/bash "$CHROOT/usr/local/bin/inventory-worker"
cat > /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service <<'INVENTORY_UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Confined inventory background worker
After=local-fs.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=inventorysvc
Group=inventorysvc
RootDirectory=/srv/inventory-worker/root
WorkingDirectory=/var/lib/inventory
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/inventory-worker
Restart=always
RestartSec=5s
NoNewPrivileges=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/inventory
ProtectHome=yes
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
ProtectKernelModules=yes
ProtectKernelLogs=yes
ProtectControlGroups=yes
RestrictSUIDSGID=yes
LockPersonality=yes
MemoryDenyWriteExecute=yes
CapabilityBoundingSet=
AmbientCapabilities=
SystemCallArchitectures=native

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
INVENTORY_UNIT
chown root:root /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service
chmod 0644 /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now inventory-worker
systemctl is-enabled inventory-worker
systemctl is-active inventory-worker
systemctl status inventory-worker --no-pager
